title: Finding the station on foot
summary: Ask a passer-by the way, choose walking or transport, clear up left versus right and confirm a landmark.

help.speaker: Passer-by
help.en: What's up? Do you need help?

variants.en: Can I help you with something?

rephrase.pinyin: Nǐ shì bu shì zài zhǎo lù?
rephrase.en: Are you trying to find your way?

choices.en: Excuse me, where is the subway station?
I'm lost

choices.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù Nánjīng Dōng Lù.
choices.en: I'm going to East Nanjing Road

where-going.speaker: Passer-by
where-going.pinyin: Bié zháojí. Nǐ yào qù nǎr?
where-going.en: Don't worry. Where are you going?

rephrase.en: What place are you trying to find?

choices.en: To the subway station

choices.zh: 回我的酒店，在南京东路。
choices.pinyin: Huí wǒ de jiǔdiàn, zài Nánjīng Dōng Lù.
choices.en: Back to my hotel, on East Nanjing Road

choices.zh: 我也不太确定，我看看地图。
choices.pinyin: Wǒ yě bú tài quèdìng, wǒ kànkan dìtú.
choices.en: I'm not quite sure — let me check the map

walk-or-ride.speaker: Passer-by
walk-or-ride.zh: 地铁站？走路十分钟，打车三分钟就到。
walk-or-ride.pinyin: Dìtiě zhàn? Zǒulù shí fēnzhōng, dǎchē sān fēnzhōng jiù dào.
walk-or-ride.en: The subway station? Ten minutes on foot, three by taxi.

variants.pinyin: Bù yuǎn, zǒu guòqu jiù xíng.
variants.en: It's not far, you can walk.

rephrase.zh: 走路要十分钟，坐出租车只要三分钟。
rephrase.pinyin: Zǒulù yào shí fēnzhōng, zuò chūzūchē zhǐ yào sān fēnzhōng.
rephrase.en: Walking takes ten minutes; a taxi takes only three.

choices.en: I'll walk
I'll take a taxi
Is there a bus?

walk-directions.speaker: Passer-by
walk-directions.zh: 一直往前走，到第二个红绿灯右转，就能看到地铁站入口。
walk-directions.pinyin: Yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu, dào dì èr ge hónglǜdēng yòu zhuǎn, jiù néng kàndào dìtiě zhàn rùkǒu.
walk-directions.en: Go straight, turn right at the second traffic light, and you'll see the station entrance.

variants.pinyin: Wǎng qián zǒu, ránhòu yòu guǎi.

rephrase.zh: 先直走，看到第二个红绿灯，往右边走，入口就在那儿。
rephrase.pinyin: Xiān zhí zǒu, kàndào dì èr ge hónglǜdēng, wǎng yòubian zǒu, rùkǒu jiù zài nàr.
rephrase.en: Walk straight first; at the second traffic light go right, and the entrance is there.

choices.zh: 第二个红绿灯右转，对吗？
choices.pinyin: Dì èr ge hónglǜdēng yòu zhuǎn, duì ma?
choices.en: Right at the second traffic light, correct?
Left or right?

choices.zh: 附近有什么明显的地方吗？
choices.pinyin: Fùjìn yǒu shénme míngxiǎn de dìfang ma?
choices.en: Is there a landmark nearby?

clarify.speaker: Passer-by
clarify.zh: 右边，右边。你看到那个银行了吗？在银行那儿右转。
clarify.pinyin: Yòubian, yòubian. Nǐ kàndào nàge yínháng le ma? Zài yínháng nàr yòu zhuǎn.
clarify.en: Right, right. See that bank? Turn right at the bank.

choices.en: I see it, thanks!

choices.pinyin: Nǐ néng zhǐ gěi wǒ kàn ma?
choices.en: Could you point it out to me?

landmark.speaker: Passer-by
landmark.zh: 有，地铁站旁边有一个很大的商场。
landmark.pinyin: Yǒu, dìtiě zhàn pángbiān yǒu yí ge hěn dà de shāngchǎng.
landmark.en: Yes, there's a big shopping mall next to the station.

choices.en: Okay, I'll look for the mall

nanjing.speaker: Passer-by
nanjing.zh: 南京东路离这儿有点远，你最好坐地铁，二号线一站就到。
nanjing.pinyin: Nánjīng Dōng Lù lí zhèr yǒudiǎn yuǎn, nǐ zuìhǎo zuò dìtiě, èr hào xiàn yí zhàn jiù dào.
nanjing.en: East Nanjing Road is a bit far from here. Best take the subway — one stop on Line 2.

rephrase.zh: 那儿有点远，坐地铁二号线比较方便，只要一站。
rephrase.pinyin: Nàr yǒudiǎn yuǎn, zuò dìtiě èr hào xiàn bǐjiào fāngbiàn, zhǐ yào yí zhàn.
rephrase.en: It's a bit far; Line 2 is easier — only one stop.

choices.en: How long is it on foot?

choices.pinyin: Hǎo, nà dìtiě zhàn zěnme zǒu?
choices.en: Okay — how do I get to the subway station?
I'll take a taxi

nanjing-walk.speaker: Passer-by
nanjing-walk.zh: 大概二十分钟，一直往东走。
nanjing-walk.pinyin: Dàgài èrshí fēnzhōng, yìzhí wǎng dōng zǒu.
nanjing-walk.en: About twenty minutes — keep heading east.

choices.en: Which way is east?

choices.zh: 那我还是坐地铁吧。地铁站怎么走？
choices.pinyin: Nà wǒ háishi zuò dìtiě ba. Dìtiě zhàn zěnme zǒu?
choices.en: I'll take the subway after all. How do I get to the station?

confirm-end.speaker: Passer-by
confirm-end.zh: 对，就在那儿。很近的，不会错过。
confirm-end.pinyin: Duì, jiù zài nàr. Hěn jìn de, bú huì cuòguò.
confirm-end.en: Yes, right there. It's close — you won't miss it.
confirm-end.outcome: You know the way to the station entrance.

point-end.speaker: Passer-by
point-end.zh: 你看，就是那个蓝色的牌子，地铁的标志。
point-end.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, jiù shì nàge lánsè de páizi, dìtiě de biāozhì.
point-end.en: Look — that blue sign. That's the subway logo.
point-end.outcome: They point out the subway sign.

taxi-end.speaker: Passer-by
taxi-end.zh: 打车的话在路口等就行，或者用手机叫车。
taxi-end.pinyin: Dǎchē dehuà zài lùkǒu děng jiù xíng, huòzhě yòng shǒujī jiào chē.
taxi-end.en: For a taxi, wait at the intersection, or call one on your phone.
taxi-end.outcome: You head to the intersection for a taxi.

bus-end.speaker: Passer-by
bus-end.zh: 有，对面坐二十路，坐两站就到。
bus-end.pinyin: Yǒu, duìmiàn zuò èrshí lù, zuò liǎng zhàn jiù dào.
bus-end.en: Yes — take bus 20 from across the street. It's two stops.
bus-end.outcome: You take bus 20 for two stops.

east-end.speaker: Passer-by
east-end.zh: 就是这个方向，跟着这条大路走就行。
east-end.pinyin: Jiù shì zhège fāngxiàng, gēnzhe zhè tiáo dà lù zǒu jiù xíng.
east-end.en: This direction. Just follow this main road.
east-end.outcome: You walk east along the main road.

map-end.speaker: Passer-by
map-end.zh: 好，你看看。要是找不到，再问我。
map-end.pinyin: Hǎo, nǐ kànkan. Yàoshi zhǎo bu dào, zài wèn wǒ.
map-end.en: Sure, have a look. If you can't find it, ask me again.
map-end.outcome: You check your map; they offer more help if needed.
